question: I've never had my chart done. Where do I start?
text: I'll open Chart Studio, where you enter your own details and the chart is calculated there.

question: What's my ascendant? I know my birth time, it's on my birth certificate
text: I'll open Chart Studio so you can enter your birth date, birth place and the time from your certificate. It works out your ascendant (rising sign) from those.

question: I'm a Gemini sun but no idea what my moon is. can you tell me?
text: I can't work out your Moon sign from your Sun sign alone. The Moon changes sign about every 2.5 days, so it depends on your exact birth date. A birth time and place make it more precise. I'll open Chart Studio so you can enter those details yourself.

question: pull up that chart wheel thing where I can put my own details in

text: I can't ping you or schedule anything, so I can't send a message the day before. Zodiacs has a sky calendar that you can subscribe to. It includes retrograde periods and updates itself, so I'll get the link.
